description: A single-turn prompt against the mock provider whose first response proposes a real tool call (git_status against the seeded fixture repo -- see seed.git_repo), so the run passes through the full spinner lifecycle: capturing the request, gathering context, calling the model, running the tool, a second model call with the tool result, and the post-turn memory-extraction spinner phases, before returning to an idle prompt and exiting via /exit. git_status is a read-only tool (src/agent_tools.zig's read_only_tool_names) so it auto-approves and never raises an interactive permission prompt -- that flow is ux-permission-prompt's job (docs/capture/scenario_corpus.md #9), not this one. Covers: spinner render frames (glyph + verb + elapsed time) across a real tool round-trip, spinner stop on completion, and (as of r3-mock-01) submitting a slash command from the fullscreen composer.
